about: Events a visitor to the Algarve can go to, 18 November 2026 to early January 2027, from the councils' own agendas, each with the page its dates were read from. Not a complete what's-on: see gaps.
checked_by_lead: travel.b@PrompTugal.dinis re-read Natal em Lagos, the Albufeira São Silvestre and the Portimão Fado Gala on 18 Nov 2026: dates match. cm-faro.pt, cm-vrsa.pt and cm-aljezur.pt did not answer from the lead's session. Dropped: Aljezur's sweet potato festival (its page title says 2025, so the year is in doubt) and Lagos's magusto (no year on its page).
